title: Over-capacity adaptive representation reuse
question: How does the bounded 32-entry adaptive-hydraulic cache behave when a MultiSWAP-like workload repeatedly uses more unique hydraulic parameterizations than the cache can hold?

workloads.sequence: 128 consecutive requests for key 1, then key 2, etc.

interpretation.no_repair_if: uncached rebuild overhead is negligible relative to application cost
interpretation.consider_eviction_if: grouped/locality workload is dominated by repeated uncached rebuilds and bounded replacement can remove them
interpretation.consider_registry_or_larger_capacity_if: round-robin workload is dominated by rebuilds, because LRU alone cannot solve a working set larger than cache capacity
